environment: Offline Ganache with injected test provider; headless Chromium
checks: A single legacy injected wallet is available when EIP-6963 discovery is absent.
With Binance occupying window.ethereum, EIP-6963 discovers Binance, MetaMask and Bybit and selects MetaMask initially.
Changing wallets while a connection is pending discards its result and leaves only the newly chosen wallet active.
Connect authorization precedes the network switch. Declining either prompt leaves signing unavailable.
A wallet that acknowledges a switch but stays on another network cannot preview a deployment.
Approving the switch to Sepolia produces a fee preview without submitting a transaction.
The signing button checks the network without switching chains or sending on a mismatched network.
A changed funding account invalidates signing.
All connection, chain switching, signing and receipt requests use the selected MetaMask instance.
Single wallet submission produces a verified runtime, three expected managers and threshold two.
Reload resumes verification of the existing hash without a second submission.
Read-only payment verification reconstructs deposit, proposal, approval, revocation, two approvals and execution.
A different receipt supplied as the execution hash is rejected.
Native ETH balances verified for a separate recipient and for a recipient who pays the execution gas.
